lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three prisoners. Five hats. Three white, two black. Guess your hat right, you walk free. Guess wrong... you don't.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The guard lines them up, one behind the other, facing a wall. Each gets a hat he can't see.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Prisoner three, at the back, sees both hats in front of him. He stays silent.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Prisoner two sees one hat. He stays silent too.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Prisoner one sees nothing. Just the wall.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And yet... he's the one who answers. And he's right.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: What color is his hat? Beat the clock.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: If prisoner three had seen two black hats, he'd know his was white. He stayed silent. So at least one front hat is white.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Prisoner two knows that too. If prisoner one's hat were black, his own would have to be white. But he stayed silent.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So prisoner one's hat... is white.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The silence was the clue. Comment if you beat the clock.
